"""Synthetic native filter cycling; no source operations or filesystem traversal."""
import json
import sys
import time
import cProfile
import pstats
from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent, QItemSelection, QItemSelectionModel, Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from je_file_tree.core.analysis import category_stats, summarise
from je_file_tree.core.node import Node
from je_file_tree.core.scanner import ScanResult
from je_file_tree.gui.i18n import set_language
from je_file_tree.gui.results_view import ResultsView
from je_file_tree.gui.scan_worker import ScanOutcome
from je_file_tree.gui.tree_model import NAME, NODE_ROLE
from je_file_tree.gui.tree_filter import ExpandedTreeProxy
from je_file_tree.gui.tree_model import FolderTreeModel

if '--before' in sys.argv:
    import importlib.util
    import je_file_tree.gui.results_view as results_module
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('selection_baseline', Path(__file__).with_name('tree_filter_endpoint_baseline.py'))
    baseline = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = baseline
    spec.loader.exec_module(baseline)
    results_module.TreeFilter = baseline.TreeFilter

if '--legacy-predicate' in sys.argv:
    def legacy_predicate(self, row, parent):
        source = self.sourceModel()
        if source is None:
            return False
        node = source.index(row, 0, parent).data(NODE_ROLE)
        return node is source.root or node is not None and id(node) in self.allowed
    ExpandedTreeProxy.filterAcceptsRow = legacy_predicate

if '--leaf-flags' in sys.argv:
    def leaf_flags(self, index):
        flags = super(FolderTreeModel, self).flags(index)
        node = self._entry(index)
        if (node is not None and not node.is_dir and not node.children
                and node not in self._archives and not node.name.lower().endswith(('.zip', '.7z', '.rar'))):
            flags |= Qt.ItemFlag.ItemNeverHasChildren
        return flags
    FolderTreeModel.flags = leaf_flags

if '--direct-predicate' in sys.argv:
    def direct_predicate(self, row, parent):
        source = self.sourceModel()
        if source is None:
            return False
        if not parent.isValid():
            node = source.root if row == 0 else None
        else:
            children = source._ordered(source._entry(parent))
            node = children[row] if 0 <= row < len(children) else None
        return node is source.root or node is not None and id(node) in self.allowed
    ExpandedTreeProxy.filterAcceptsRow = direct_predicate

if '--proxy-flags' in sys.argv:
    def proxy_flags(self, index):
        return (Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
                if index.isValid() else Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags)
    ExpandedTreeProxy.flags = proxy_flags

if '--cached-leaf-flags' in sys.argv:
    BASE_FLAGS = Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
    LEAF_FLAGS = BASE_FLAGS | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemNeverHasChildren
    def cached_leaf_flags(self, index):
        node = self._entry(index)
        if node is None:
            return Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags
        if (not node.is_dir and not node.children and node not in self._archives
                and not self._orders.get(id(node))
                and not node.name.lower().endswith(('.zip', '.7z', '.rar'))):
            return LEAF_FLAGS
        return BASE_FLAGS
    FolderTreeModel.flags = cached_leaf_flags

if '--defer-repaint' in sys.argv:
    from je_file_tree.gui.tree_filter import TreeFilter
    original_switch = TreeFilter._switch
    def deferred_switch(self, filtered):
        enabled = self.tree.updatesEnabled()
        self.tree.setUpdatesEnabled(False)
        try:
            return original_switch(self, filtered)
        finally:
            self.tree.setUpdatesEnabled(enabled)
    TreeFilter._switch = deferred_switch

app = QApplication([])
set_language('en')
heartbeat = QTimer(app)
heartbeat.setInterval(5)
last_tick = time.perf_counter()
gaps = []
def tick():
    global last_tick
    now = time.perf_counter()
    gaps.append((now-last_tick)*1000)
    last_tick = now
heartbeat.timeout.connect(tick)
heartbeat.start()
count = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 20000
cycles = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[2].isdigit() else 5
root = Node('filter-lifetime-records', True, children=[], file_count=count)
root.children.extend(Node(f'file-{n:06d}.bin', False, size=count-n, file_count=1, parent=root)
                     for n in range(count))
root.size = sum(node.size for node in root.children)
summary = summarise(root, now=1800000000)
view = ResultsView()
view.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DontShowOnScreen)
view.resize(1200, 800)
view.show_outcome(ScanOutcome(ScanResult(root, [], 0), summary.largest, summary.extensions,
                              category_stats(summary.extensions), summary.ages, summary.now))
view.show()
app.processEvents()
parent = view.tree_model.index(0, 0)
picked = QItemSelection()
mode = 'sparse' if '--sparse' in sys.argv else 'all'
wanted = set(root.children[::100] if mode == 'sparse' else root.children)
if mode == 'sparse':
    for row in range(0, count, 100):
        index = view.tree_model.index(row, NAME, parent)
        picked.select(index, index)
else:
    picked.select(view.tree_model.index(0, NAME, parent), view.tree_model.index(count-1, NAME, parent))
view.tree.selectionModel().select(picked, QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.ClearAndSelect
                                 | QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.Rows)
switches = []
switch = view.tree_filter._switch
profiler = cProfile.Profile() if '--profile' in sys.argv else None
def measured_switch(filtered):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    original_sort = view.tree_model.sort
    original_preserve = view.tree_model.preserve_sort
    if '--force-rebind-sort' in sys.argv:
        view.tree_model.preserve_sort = nullcontext
    requested_sorts = []
    if '--skip-rebind-sort' in sys.argv:
        def same_sort(column, order):
            assert (column, order) == (view.tree_model._sort_column, view.tree_model._sort_order)
            requested_sorts.append((column, str(order)))
        view.tree_model.sort = same_sort
    if profiler:
        profiler.enable()
    try:
        return switch(filtered)
    finally:
        view.tree_model.sort = original_sort
        view.tree_model.preserve_sort = original_preserve
        if profiler:
            profiler.disable()
        switches.append({'filtered': filtered, 'selection_ranges': len(view.tree.selectionModel().selection()), 'ms': round((time.perf_counter()-started)*1000, 2),
                         'suppressed_sorts': requested_sorts})
view.tree_filter._switch = measured_switch
ready = view.tree_filter._ready
if '--skip-unchanged' in sys.argv:
    def changed_ready(worker, allowed):
        controller = view.tree_filter
        if (not controller._closed and worker is controller._current and not worker.cancel.is_set()
                and worker.root is controller.source.root and controller.proxy.allowed == allowed
                and controller.proxy.sourceModel() is controller.source and controller.tree.model() is controller.proxy):
            return
        ready(worker, allowed)
    view.tree_filter._ready = changed_ready

def settle():
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
    while view.tree_filter.timer.isActive() or view.tree_filter._workers:
        assert time.monotonic() < deadline
        app.processEvents()
        time.sleep(.005)
    app.processEvents()
    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)

def observe(cycle):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    view.tree.sortByColumn(NAME, Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)
    elapsed = (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000
    settle()
    assert {index.data(NODE_ROLE) for index in view.tree.selectionModel().selectedRows()} == wanted
    return {'cycle': cycle, 'selection_models': len(view.tree.findChildren(QItemSelectionModel)),
            'sort_ms': round(elapsed, 2), 'source_persistent_indexes': len(view.tree_model.persistentIndexList()),
            'selection_owners': {type(owner).__name__: len(owner.findChildren(
                QItemSelectionModel, options=Qt.FindChildOption.FindDirectChildrenOnly))
                for owner in (view.tree, view.tree.header())},
            'header_shares_active_selection': view.tree.header().selectionModel() is view.tree.selectionModel()}

try:
    results = [observe(0)]
    updates = []
    if '--updates' in sys.argv:
        for query in ('file-', 'FILE-', 'file-0', 'FILE-0'):
            started = time.perf_counter()
            gaps.clear()
            last_tick = started
            view.tree_filter.line.setText(query)
            settle()
            ended = time.perf_counter()
            elapsed = (ended-started)*1000
            max_gap = max([*gaps, (ended-last_tick)*1000])
            assert view.tree.model() is view.tree_filter.proxy
            assert view.tree_filter.proxy.rowCount(view.tree_filter.index_for(root)) == count
            assert {index.data(NODE_ROLE) for index in view.tree.selectionModel().selectedRows()} == wanted
            updates.append({'query': query, 'ms': round(elapsed, 2), 'gui_max_gap_ms': round(max_gap, 2)})
    for cycle in range(1, cycles + 1):
        view.tree_filter.line.setText('file-')
        settle()
        assert view.tree.model() is view.tree_filter.proxy
        view.tree_filter.line.clear()
        settle()
        assert view.tree.model() is view.tree_model
        results.append(observe(cycle))
    print(json.dumps({'platform': app.platformName(), 'files': count, 'selected': len(wanted),
                      'cycles': results, 'selection_mode': mode, 'before': '--before' in sys.argv, 'sources_modified': False, 'switches': switches, 'updates': updates}))
    if profiler:
        pstats.Stats(profiler).sort_stats('cumulative').print_stats(24)
finally:
    view.tree_filter.shutdown()
    for panel in (view.search, view.duplicates, view.cleanup, view.users, view.changes, view.details):
        panel.stop(wait=True)
    view.wait_for_lists()
    view.close()
